interface.shortDescription: Turn a question into a checked research study
interface.longDescription: Scientist1 helps you turn a research question into a full study in Codex. You explain what you want to find out and approve the plan once. Specialist AI agents then move the study autonomously through nine stages: planning, literature review, method development, selection, component testing, writing, claim checking, integrity audit, and delivery. The number of agents adapts to the approved study. Before the work can finish, Scientist1 checks that the numbers in the paper match the saved test results and that each important claim points to a source or saved result that supports it. Review failures use a release-owned finite checklist, independent adjudication, a frozen exact-scope repair docket, and bound closure review, preventing false-positive rollback and open-ended re-review. Repeated defects require a changed causal strategy. Only fresh verification of the complete paper package can finish an approved study. You receive the paper with its sources, code, results, and check reports, so you can see how it reached its conclusions.
defaultPrompt: Scientist1, help me plan a study.
Audit this research bundle with Scientist1.
